linkUnavailableDescription: The booking link may be wrong or inactive. Reach out to the clinic directly.
error: This booking link is not valid or the location is unavailable.
unavailableDescription: Try again later or contact the location directly.

hero.description: Fill in the steps below to request a visit. Staff confirm before it's final.

howItWorks.title: How booking works
howItWorks.description: Three quick steps before the clinic confirms your visit.
howItWorks.privacyBody: Only you and this care team see what you enter. Submitting is a request until staff confirms your visit.

slotGrid.selectDoctorDescription: Tap a doctor to see open times for the day you picked, or tap 'Any doctor' to see all available slots.
slotGrid.doctorOptionalDescription: If you choose a doctor, you can pick an exact time. Otherwise, you can request a date only and the clinic will assign a doctor and time.
slotGrid.unavailableDescription: Open times could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
slotGrid.noOpeningsDescription: There are no free times left on this date. The times below are already booked, blocked, or earlier in the day. Choose another date if you need an opening.
slotGrid.noOpeningsInRangeTitle: No openings in this time range
slotGrid.noOpeningsInRangeDescription: Try a wider window or clear the time range to see all openings for this day.

slotEmpty.FULL_DAY_BLOCKED: This doctor is marked away for the full day you selected. Choose another date on the calendar.
slotEmpty.DATE_PARSE_ERROR: That date could not be read correctly. Pick the day again on the calendar.
slotEmpty.NO_SLOTS_IN_RANGE: Visit hours look incomplete for this day (no time slots could be built from the schedule). Please contact the clinic.
slotEmpty.NO_WEEKLY_HOURS: No visit hours are set for this weekday for this doctor or clinic (using the clinic time zone). Try another day, or contact the clinic.

summaryPeek.empty: No day or slot selected yet
summaryPeek.sheetDescription: Doctor, day, and time for this visit request.

doneCard.description: The care team will reach out to confirm your visit using the contact method they have on file.

nextSteps.contact: They contact you to confirm the time
nextSteps.confirmed: Your visit is confirmed once they reach out

reviewBlock.description: Submitting sends a request only — the clinic confirms before your visit is final.

actionPanel.disclaimer: Submitting sends a request only — the care team confirms before it is a firm appointment.

verification.newPatientDescription: We did not find an existing chart for this phone number at this location yet. Submit your request and staff will confirm your visit.
verification.verifyDescription: This phone matches records at this location. Request a one-time code via WhatsApp, then enter it so we can show your recent visits.
verification.skipOtp: New patient / can't receive WhatsApp? Continue without code

dpdpConsent.label: I have read this notice and consent to my personal and health data being processed per the description above.

appointmentSection.title: Doctor, date, and time

appointmentSection.tapDate: Tap a date on the calendar
appointmentSection.pickDayHint: Pick a day now. The clinic will confirm the exact time after approval.

contactSection.title: Your contact details
contactSection.description: Please use the same phone this {facility} has on file when possible, so we can match your request to your chart.
